verdict.rationale: An API that matches the UI is a fair thing to ask of an authenticator or password manager, so this story applies. But 2FAS's own llms.txt states 'Public API: None' (local-first, no agent-callable endpoint), and every OpenAPI/Swagger path probed returned 404. The '2FAS API' in the docs is for services to offer one-click 2FA enrollment, not programmatic access to everything the app's UI can do.
